label: Controls for the nine-restricted self-operation premises, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit two-being interpretations, checked by unfolding
meaning: Strictness: an inert pure act without intellect (and so without the nine) satisfies both nine-restricted premises and falsifies STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES, so the weak versions do not entail the strong ones. Nonvacuity: some being has the nine and lives at some time. Independence from the intellect bridge: the nine-restricted life premise and the restricted sense bridge hold where an intellectual pure act is not LIVING_1, so the route does not formally presuppose 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 lives', not even restricted to pure acts. Sense mixing fails without the bridge: a being with the nine can be LIVING_2 and not LIVING_1, so the weak life premise alone does not give the living conjunct. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; the inert pure act shows where each strong version is needed, not that any being is such a pure act.
